recovery_basis: Required upstream Gate/specification/PD sources unavailable as local canonical files; approved recovery archives verified against retained entry identities; local CEP prompts take precedence

rows.Purpose: Record environment-specific verification only after implementation availability.
rows.Required External Dependencies: EXT-0020; EXT-0021; EXT-0022; EXT-0023; EXT-0024 as applicable
rows.Evidence Required: Executed runtime scenarios, environment/build identity, logs/results, explicit PASS/FAIL per verification item.
rows.Pass Condition: Required verification items have executed evidence; no static evidence is promoted to runtime PASS.
rows.Failure Consequence: Affected production/UAT/certification decisions remain blocked or UTV.
rows.Downstream Work Unlocked: UAT convergence and Production Certification evidence
rows.Notes: Not every feature requires every verification item.

rows.Purpose: Record completion of the approved representative UAT execution without conflating UAT with Production Certification or Human Sign-off.
rows.Evidence Required: Scenario-by-scenario runtime results for all 44 approved representative cases with build/environment identity.
rows.Pass Condition: All 44 approved representative UAT scenarios are executed as applicable; required evidence is captured; unresolved failures are explicitly dispositioned; no exhaustive-UAT claim is made. Passing GATE-10 does not constitute Human Sign-off.
rows.Failure Consequence: Production acceptance/human sign-off cannot claim UAT completion.
rows.Notes: REPRESENTATIVE UAT COMPLETE ≠ PRODUCTION CERTIFICATION COMPLETE ≠ HUMAN SIGN-OFF. HUMAN SIGN-OFF: NOT EXECUTED.

rows.Purpose: Certify production/system-operational readiness only after GATE-10 Representative UAT Completion and all existing production readiness controls/evidence are satisfied.
rows.Evidence Required: Activated official statutory package where applicable; backup/restore evidence; deployment drill; observability/incident drill; supply-chain re-verification; approved topology/recovery/operating evidence.
rows.Pass Condition: GATE-10 Representative UAT Completion has PASSED; all required Production Certification IMB items are complete; required runtime/production evidence is available; required external production evidence is available; and no unresolved production-certification blocker remains.
rows.Failure Consequence: Production certification remains NOT COMPLETE regardless of feature/UAT state.
rows.Downstream Work Unlocked: Future production release decision and Human Sign-off review
rows.Notes: GATE-10 → GATE-11 is mandatory. PRODUCTION CERTIFICATION ≠ HUMAN SIGN-OFF. GATE-11 is not currently passed.

rows.Purpose: Record final explicit human/business acceptance only after Representative UAT Completion and Production Certification.
rows.Evidence Required: Explicit authorized human sign-off linked to reviewed build and evidence set.
rows.Pass Condition: GATE-10 Representative UAT Completion has PASSED AND GATE-11 Production Certification has PASSED AND EXT-0026 contains an explicit authorized Human Business Sign-off record.
rows.Failure Consequence: HUMAN SIGN-OFF remains NOT EXECUTED; documentation/product decisions do not substitute.
rows.Notes: GATE-10 → GATE-11 → GATE-12. EXT-0026 applies only to GATE-12. HUMAN SIGN-OFF: NOT EXECUTED.
